# Retail CoD UO 1.51b dedicated server, 2026-10-20: the PROBE lines of
# client-probes/probe_vehblast on mp_peaks.
# COD_VERSION=uo PORT=33751 PROBE_SECS=70 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_vehblast mp_peaks
#   +set probe_vehicletype willyjeep_mp +set probe_weapon bazooka_mp +set probe_shots 2
#   +set probe_dist 250 +set probe_dist_0 300 +set probe_side_0 150 +set probe_z_0 0
#   +set probe_z_1 20
# then, 18 s in, the shooter: vcod --game-dir <UO> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:33751
#   --probe-team allies --probe-weapon thompson_mp --probe-uo-weapon direct --probe-secs 45
#   --save-snapshots --capture-tag uo-blastjeep (crates/common/tests/fixtures/net/*-uo-blastjeep.bin).
# The first bazooka round strikes the ground 150 off the empty Willys's flank: its splash is
# under 100 and the jeep takes nothing. The second strikes its flank for 899 (1000 times the
# f32 0.9), under its script's health buffer, and the jeep script kills it inside the notify;
# its wreck's blast reaches the shooter 10.5 s later.
